name: How long does it take to complete a desert landscaping project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a desert landscaping project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a desert landscaping project depends on its scope and complexity. A small-scale conversion or refresh might be completed within a few days to a week. Larger projects involving extensive hardscaping, grading, irrigation installation, and multiple planting zones could take several weeks, or even a few months for very intricate designs. Factors like weather, material availability, and permit requirements (if applicable) can also influence the timeline. Your contractor can provide a more precise schedule after design finalization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies: small desert landscaping can take days to a week, while larger, complex designs may take several weeks to months.
